sentence: This project supports cancer research, from clinical to basic science, that aims to reduce the burden of cancer for patients.
This project builds tiny lights on a probe that record and stimulate brain cells, to study how neural circuits work in animals.
This project develops and tests an ultrasound technology to evaluate Crohn's disease safely, so treatment can be adjusted more often.
This project tries to find out how changes in a kinase enzyme cause several diseases, including a type of liver cancer.
This project studies how mutations in certain genes change a protein complex, gene regulation and brain development.
This project studies how stress in adolescence changes a brain circuit from the amygdala to dopamine neurons, and how that relates to addictive behaviors.
This project builds peptide-linked molecules that stop Nipah virus from replicating, since no antiviral therapies exist for it.
This project tries to find out why people with sickle cell disease develop more blood cancers, using mice and deep sequencing of genes.
This project tests whether machine learning tools can identify young children in sub-Saharan Africa who are at risk of dying after leaving hospital.
This project studies how different microbes in the human gut adapt so they can live together in the same ecosystem.
This project studies how mutations in a gene cause early problems in brain cell growth and movement in Rett Syndrome.
This project studies how calcium channels in a brain region called the thalamus shape the effects of morphine and opioid addiction.
This project builds models of the gene networks that control early human development, using genomic and proteomic measurements.
This project studies the genetic basis of traits that help house mice adapt to their environment, and how this relates to human health.
This project builds computer tools that read kidney biopsies automatically to help doctors care for patients with nephrotic syndrome.
This project builds a light-controlled system and an animal model to control and watch how persister cells form during bacterial infections.
This project supports a center that builds research resources to help understand and treat vascular diseases of the lungs and heart.
This project builds a wearable ultrasound imager that lets doctors watch the heart continuously without surgery.
This project designs a nanoparticle that activates innate immune cells so the body can attack tumors and stop cancer from coming back.
This project provides light-sheet microscopy and image analysis tools to help scientists make 3D images of whole cleared tissue.
